title: iRun Subic Bay 2026 Leg 3 Review: A Single-Distance Full Marathon at Remy Field
seo_title: iRun Subic Bay Leg 3 2026 Review | Subic Philippines Marathon
meta_description: iRun Subic Bay 2026 Leg 3: November 29 at Remy Field, Subic. A single-distance full marathon (42.195K) from SMOKE10 Events. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 29 November 2026 at Remy Field in Subic, Zambales, this SMOKE10 Events production is a rare single-distance event: a full marathon only. No 10K, no 5K, no half — just 42.195km. Registration isn't open yet.
verdict: iRun Subic Bay Leg 3 is a focused proposition: one distance (42.195km), one venue (Remy Field, Subic), one organiser (SMOKE10 Events). In a region where multi-distance festivals are the norm, a standalone full marathon is genuinely distinctive — it suggests a race built for marathoners, not a fun-run festival with a marathon tacked on. Subic Bay's wide, well-maintained roads — a legacy of its former US naval base — make it one of the Philippines' best running environments. Registration isn't open yet, but for serious marathoners, this is one to track.

sections.heading: Subic Bay: A Runner's Enclave
paragraphs: Subic Bay Freeport's wide, well-maintained roads and minimal traffic — a legacy of the former US naval base — make it one of the Philippines' premier running venues. [1] Remy Field, the race venue, is a central location within the freeport with space for a proper start/finish precinct.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a focused, single-distance full marathon in one of the Philippines' best running environments, track iRun Subic Bay. The 2026 Leg 3 is set for 29 November at Remy Field, Subic. [1]
